# vector-store-lite

> Embedded vector store on stdlib sqlite3 with float32 blobs, metadata filters compiled to parameterised SQL, exact search and seeded random-hyperplane LSH Python package `trysac-vector-store-lite`, import name `vector_store_lite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
